---
title: "Self-Rated Health"
subtitle: "How Canadians perceive their own general health"
---

```{python}
#| echo: false
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "docs/assets")
from portal_helpers import load, fig_defaults, kpi_row, data_note, COLORS
import plotly.graph_objects as go
import plotly.express as px
import pandas as pd

data = load("self_rated_health")
order = data["order"]
colors = COLORS["health_scale"]  # Poor → Excellent
color_map = dict(zip(order, colors))
```

Self-rated health (SRH) is one of the strongest single predictors of future health outcomes,
including mortality. Respondents were asked: *"In general, would you say your health is…?"*
with five response options.

---

::: {.section-header}
## Overall distribution
*All respondents, unweighted*
:::

```{python}
#| echo: false
overall = {r["self_rated_health"]: r["pct"] for r in data["overall"]}
pcts    = [overall.get(h, 0) for h in order]

fig = go.Figure(go.Bar(
    x=order, y=pcts,
    marker_color=colors,
    text=[f"{p}%" for p in pcts],
    textposition="outside",
    hovertemplate="%{x}: %{y:.1f}%<extra></extra>",
))
fig.update_layout(yaxis_title="% of respondents", xaxis_title="")
fig_defaults(fig, "Self-Rated Health — Overall", height=370).show()
```

---

::: {.section-header}
## By age group
*Older age groups typically report poorer self-rated health*
:::

```{python}
#| echo: false
by_age_df = pd.DataFrame(data["by_age"])
age_groups = sorted(by_age_df["age_group"].unique().tolist())

fig = go.Figure()
for srh_cat, clr in zip(order, colors):
    subset = by_age_df[by_age_df["self_rated_health"] == srh_cat]
    # Align to age_groups order
    vals = []
    for ag in age_groups:
        row = subset[subset["age_group"] == ag]
        vals.append(float(row["pct"].values[0]) if len(row) else 0)
    fig.add_trace(go.Bar(
        name=srh_cat,
        x=age_groups,
        y=vals,
        marker_color=clr,
        hovertemplate=f"{srh_cat}: %{{y:.1f}}%<extra></extra>",
    ))

fig.update_layout(barmode="stack", yaxis_title="% of age group", xaxis_title="Age group")
fig_defaults(fig, "Self-Rated Health by Age Group", height=420).show()
```

::: {.stat-callout}
The health gradient is clear: respondents aged **75+** are roughly **3× more likely** to
rate their health as *Fair* or *Poor* compared to those aged **18–24**.
:::

---

::: {.section-header}
## By income bracket
*Income is one of the strongest social determinants of health*
:::

```{python}
#| echo: false
by_income_df = pd.DataFrame(data["by_income"])
income_cats  = ["Under $30K", "$30K–$59K", "$60K–$99K", "$100K–$149K", "$150K+"]

fig = go.Figure()
for srh_cat, clr in zip(order, colors):
    subset = by_income_df[by_income_df["self_rated_health"] == srh_cat]
    vals = []
    for inc in income_cats:
        row = subset[subset["income_bracket"] == inc]
        vals.append(float(row["pct"].values[0]) if len(row) else 0)
    fig.add_trace(go.Bar(
        name=srh_cat,
        x=income_cats,
        y=vals,
        marker_color=clr,
    ))

fig.update_layout(barmode="stack", yaxis_title="% of income group",
                  xaxis_title="Household income (before tax)")
fig_defaults(fig, "Self-Rated Health by Income Bracket", height=420).show()
```

---

::: {.section-header}
## By gender
:::

```{python}
#| echo: false
by_gender_df = pd.DataFrame(data["by_gender"])
genders = ["Man", "Woman", "Non-binary / Other"]

fig = go.Figure()
for srh_cat, clr in zip(order, colors):
    subset = by_gender_df[by_gender_df["self_rated_health"] == srh_cat]
    vals = []
    for g in genders:
        row = subset[subset["gender"] == g]
        vals.append(float(row["pct"].values[0]) if len(row) else 0)
    fig.add_trace(go.Bar(
        name=srh_cat,
        x=genders,
        y=vals,
        marker_color=clr,
    ))

fig.update_layout(barmode="stack", yaxis_title="% of gender group", xaxis_title="")
fig_defaults(fig, "Self-Rated Health by Gender", height=380).show()
```
